title: Preimage Size of Factorial Zeroes

monster.name: Legendre Archon
monster.title: Counter of Factorial Factors of 5
monster.defeatQuote: Count of integers x whose x! ends in exactly k zeroes evaluated!

description: Let `f(x)` be the number of zeroes at the end of `x!`. Given `k`, find the number of non-negative integers `x` have the property that `f(x) = k`. (Note: the answer is always either 0 or 5).
solutionCode:
def preimageSizeFZF(k: int) -> int:
    def trailing_zeroes(x):
        res = 0
        while x > 0:
            res += x // 5
            x //= 5
        return res
    lo, hi = 0, 5 * (k + 1)
    while lo <= hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        tz = trailing_zeroes(mid)
        if tz == k: return 5
        elif tz < k: lo = mid + 1
        else: hi = mid - 1
    return 0
hints: Binary search for any x where trailing_zeroes(x) == k. If found, exactly 5 numbers share this count.
